no-restricted-syntax.message: Do not use literal colors in cn(). Use CSS custom properties instead (e.g., 'bg-[var(--accent)]').
Do not use literal colors in cn(). Use CSS custom properties instead (e.g., 'bg-[var(--accent)]').

An unscoped page.getByLabel or page.getByText with a plain string matches any label or text containing it — a control in the global header included, which is how the persona switch was taken for a select on 2026-09-13. Pass { exact: true }; or scope it to the region, dialog or card it belongs to; or, if a substring is what you mean, say so with a RegExp. See tests/unit/locator-guard.test.ts.

An unscoped page.getByRole with a plain-string name matches any element of that role whose name contains it, anywhere on the page. Pass { exact: true }; or scope it to the region, dialog or card it belongs to; or, if a substring is what you mean, say so with a RegExp. See tests/unit/locator-guard.test.ts.
